# The project vocabulary: terms that are correct here and that a general English
# dictionary does not carry. Entries are regular expressions, matched
# case-sensitively unless the pattern says otherwise.
#
# Spelling itself is enforced by `typos` rather than by Vale -- the two overlap,
# and typos understands identifiers and code far better. This list exists so that
# the register rules, and any future Vale rule that consults the vocabulary, do
# not trip over the discipline's own words.

# --- the project and its layers ------------------------------------------------
EconFlow
Galaxy
Deadalus
